priorReviewScope: Retained as an exact earlier snapshot; its runner/task/workflow hashes precede the separately reviewed phase observer and accepted-state checks below.
findings: Geometry sampler independently scans actual native and actual drawn index/position arrays at three mouth planes; raw semantic labels are retained. It never assumes a native-to-draw prefix, never updates/renders, and the runner requires nonempty untruncated sections plus independent exact full-state and solver-call equality.

Dental-stage observer forwards the original iterator and preserves its receiver, arguments and result. It copies positions only at factory entry and natural done:true; exceptions are not labelled completed. It restores the collection descriptor only after both inherited wrappers unwind.
The observer explicitly distinguishes exposed outer R06 apply identity from private R05 closure identity. Actual R05/R06 calls and last completed/restored reports must agree with observed iterations.
Diagnostic originals must reproduce the accepted R06 QA full state and actual RGBA after explicit camera/light alignment; stage observation cannot silently alter accepted native output.

Surface windows contain no pose/native update or R06 report while their compile hook is active. They verify actual GPU mode, original uniform identities and values, protected buffers and settings; restore original functions before querying R05/R06.

Every surface window must restore the complete native state, solver calls, actual original expanded GLSL and actual original pixels. Frame difference is diagnostic response only; it is not quality acceptance.
Source/build/evidence identities remain separate; all diagnosis product/visual/publication acceptance flags are false. The branch is isolated and mutations use expected-head fast-forward only.
limitations: Helper fixtures and syntax checks are not a GPU/browser run.
Draw sections are attribute-space geometry before any GPU-only skinning/morph/displacement, with mesh matrix and limitation explicitly recorded.
No tissue thickness, measured anatomy, collision correctness or visible improvement is concluded before inspecting actual results.
